case_title: TRINH DUONG VS. PAUL ANDREW KWOK

docket_entries.description: STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE JUDGE PRO TEM JEAN MILEFF FILED BY DUONG, TRINH KWOK, PAUL ANDREW

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-27-2012 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUN-13-2013 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. CASE SETTLED. DEFENDANT AGREES TO PAY PLAINTIFF A TOTAL OF $10,000.00 IN MONTHLY INSTALLMENTS OF $500.00. THE FIRST PAYMENT IS DUE ON OR BEFORW JANUARY 10, 2013. SUBSEQUENT PAYMENTS DUE ON OR BEFORE THE 10TH DAY OF EACH MONTH UNTIL PAID IN FULL. CASE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUNE 13, 2013 AT 3:30 PM. SUBSEQUENT PROGRESS REPORTS AT 6-MONTH INTERVALS. APPEARANCE BY BOTH PARTIES. JUDGE PRO TEM: JEAN MILEFF. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
RETURNED MAIL: CONTINUE ORDER MAILED 12/31/2012 TO TRINH DUONG.

NO APPEARANCES BY BOTH PARTIES. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE BASED ON PROGRESS REPORT OF 6/13/14. PLAINTIFF WAS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS NOT PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (D-506)
